title: Opening Range Break Direction
summary: Of the sessions with a formed opening range, how often the FIRST break went the chosen way. Up-rate and down-rate share this denominator, so the two runs plus the never-broke remainder partition every session exactly. Grouped by weekday by default, since directional drift is where day-of-week claims usually live — check each row's N and interval before crediting one.
deltas: any opening-range window, not a fixed menu
up and down runs share one denominator, so the partition always adds up
per-weekday N and 95% CI on the directional rate
